page.notes: The left edge carries show-through and stray marks from the facing page; these were left out. The first letter of "serenissim." (in the top paragraph and in the italic paragraph) is printed in a long-s-like form and could also be read as "f"; it is transcribed as "s". Spelling of "Traquariae", "Glasguensis" and "iniuria" follows the printed forms as far as legible.
